headline: Crewed Catamaran: €800 Deposit
primaryText:
Book before November 11th and unlock unbeatable terms for your group getaway! 🌊✨

Here’s what you get:
💰 €800 total deposit
🗓️ Flexible dates & routes (change up to 90 days out)
🔥 Up to 20% OFF on your 2027 sailing holiday

Imagine sailing across the Mediterranean, diving into turquoise bays, and creating unforgettable memories aboard your private catamaran with your family and best friends 🏝️🥂

Tag your group chat and lock in this exclusive deal before November 11th! ⛵👇
whyItWorks: The ad targets a whole friend or family group and asks viewers to tag their group chat, which spreads it socially and turns one viewer into several prospects. A low upfront deposit, flexible changes and a percentage discount lower the risk of committing to a big trip, while a firm cutoff date adds urgency. The image pairs a sunny group-on-deck photo with a price-tag graphic that repeats the key terms at a glance.
